scoring_justification: Full recompute of PDOS orbital fraction infeasible because total PDOS column not in output contract; band gap and angle are recomputed, PDOS checked structurally for positive contribution.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference thresholds for FeTP NO band gap (≥0.5 eV) and Fe–N–O angle (148° ±10°). Derived from paper-reported angle ~148° and metal-insulator transition with gap >0.5 eV per task scope.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper (Surface and Interface Analysis 2008) reports Fe–N–O angle ~148°; task specification defines insulating band gap >0.5 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and task design; angle tolerance 10° to account for DFT toolchain differences.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The angle is the paper’s reported value; the gap threshold is derived from the metal-insulator transition claim (insulating requires finite gap).

schema.description: A single line containing either a floating-point number (eV) or the word 'metallic'.

outputs.description: Majority-spin band gap of isolated FeTP, extracted from the computed band structure.
Projected density of states of Fe d_yz, meso-C p_z, and β-C p_z orbitals for FeTP within ±1 eV of the Fermi level.

schema.description: Line 1: band gap in eV; line 2: Fe–N–O angle in degrees.

outputs.description: Band gap of FeTP–NO complex and Fe–N–O adsorption geometry angle.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the FeTP band gap metric from the raw band structure CSV (provided as process evidence) and compares the submitted text against a threshold. The PDOS fraction is recomputed from the CSV and compared against a threshold. The FeTP–NO gap and angle are extracted from the two-line file and checked against paper-comparable tolerances.

steps.description: Check if the majority-spin band gap is <= 0.1 eV (or explicitly metallic).
Validate PDOS data and ensure combined contribution of target orbitals > 0.1 within ±1 eV.
